name: David O'Reilly
headline: Sr. Director, Corporate Partnerships and Business Development Toronto Blue Jays
position: Senior Director, Corporate Partnerships and Business Development
about:
- Diverse background with 13 years of professional experience focused on trade marketing, category management, experiential marketing and sales.
- Results driven and proven track record of delivering results at each level in a top tier consumer goods company. 
- Ability to forge relationships with key stakeholders to integrate and implement solutions to drive sales.

experiences.position: Senior Director, Corporate Partnerships and Business Development

experiences.description:
- Lead a team of 4 individuals and manage budget that encompasses all national trade programming. 
- Build and develop the strategy for the national brand commercial plan. 
- Delivered initiatives that revolutionized trade activity providing the sales team with a point of difference in the market place in order to upsell customers and secure incremental share & floor space.
- Developed national trade strategy to support the launch of brand innovations (Budweiser Shot / Bud Light Lime Mojito / Michelob Ultra).
- Secured strategic partnerships to maximize ROI on trade marketing promotional activity.  
- Leveraged US best practices to drive synergies for Canadian trade marketing programming.
- Implemented new price / pack strategy to close product gaps with key customer such as Costco

- Developed and implemented brand marketing plan to deliver annual volume and market share targets.
- Project lead in managing & developing the strategy to support Keith’s Birthday which is a fully integrated National promotional property.
- Managed the Keith’s marketing budget with a focus on reducing fixed costs to reinvest back into working dollars funding new initiatives not in the plan.  
- Lead role in developing the strategy to support the launch of Alexander Keith’s Premium White.
